review_conclusion: I accept the saved validation, count and scoped assembly evidence for a fresh EXP-003/EXP-005 timing comparison; performance is not yet measured.

correctness_findings.oracle_scope: I checked ordinary modular forward arithmetic without calling either reducer; the oracle shares the twiddle table and transform layout. Tests sample input patterns and do not replace the range argument.
correctness_findings.compatibility_scope: I verified exact public key, secret key, ciphertext and shared-secret transcript bytes, including sampled corrupt/random ciphertext, malformed secret key and noncanonical public key cases, across original reference/candidate and normal/UBSan builds.
correctness_findings.prior_arithmetic: I preserved the accepted EXP-001/002/003 source bytes and caller contracts; unchanged standalone arithmetic oracles were not rerun.

assembly_findings.normal_build: GCC 13.3.0 x86-64, recorded normal flags; no sanitizer or counter instrumentation.
assembly_findings.normalization: I compare function sizes and instructions with byte offsets, operands, branch destinations and referenced symbols retained; relocation addresses are normalised. nm independently confirms symbol sizes.
assembly_findings.control: I extracted the accepted EXP-003 control from hash-verified RUN-0002 binaries. Its keygen bodies also match the saved original-reference bodies after relocation normalization.
assembly_findings.changed_call_path: I found one retained skpv polyvec_ntt call and K direct ntt calls on fixed error-polynomial offsets. The compiler unrolls the new loop for K=2,3,4; final polyvec_add, polyvec_reduce and serialization remain.
assembly_findings.keygen_control_flow: For Kyber512 only the canary-failure conditional remains in this entry body; Kyber768 also has the public matrix-vector loop. Kyber1024 includes unchanged inlined public-matrix rejection sampling with data-dependent acceptance branches on values derived from the public matrix seed, plus fixed noise/matrix loops and the canary check. I do not describe the entire keygen body as branchless or its duration as input-independent.
assembly_findings.secret_error_path: The added direct calls have fixed addresses and no error-coefficient-dependent branch or index. Unchanged NTT branches/conditional move use public loop state, with public twiddle indices. Reducers use fixed arithmetic with no branch, division or indirect transfer.
assembly_findings.hardening: All six compared keygen bodies retain the stack-canary load/check/failure call, endbr64 and their one/two/three stack-page probes. Instruction presence is not proof of runtime CET enforcement or a whole-program memory-safety guarantee.
assembly_findings.stack_scope: Reservations plus six saved registers (48 bytes); entry return address and all callee frames excluded. This is local function stack use, not peak KEM stack consumption.
assembly_findings.performance_confounders: Reduced Barrett calls coexist with keygen code growth, register/spill and stack-layout changes and wrapper bypass. Timing cannot attribute an observed gain solely to individual Barrett-call cost.

security_findings.arithmetic_and_scale: I confirmed the exact reviewed call-site edit. Noise ETA1 bounds hold for all CBD outputs. The retained final reduction restores the same centred residues; neither Montgomery scale nor cryptographic parameters/noise distribution changes.
security_findings.composition: Raw e is only added after poly_tomont and before final polyvec_reduce; it is not a multiplication or inverse-transform input. skpv reduction and all wide-dot/inverse input-centring contracts remain.
security_findings.inherited_tradeoff: The earlier EXP-002 dot-product local-canary removal remains inherited. EXP-005 removes no keygen canary.
security_findings.assumptions: The claim is conditional on this pinned source, K=2/3/4, ETA1=3/2/2, current consumer path and recorded GCC/x86-64 signed conversion/shift behavior. Altered caller ranges or consumers need reassessment.
not_established: portable C behavior on other targets

review_method.source_identity_method: I verified SHA-1-checked stored commit/tree/blob objects and current SHA-256 values without invoking Git.
